jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

Oversees gear, logistical, and cost aspects of all shows in a professional,

efficient, and timely manner.

Responsibilities

Builds strong Rep partnerships
Provides accurate & complete show information
Manages the project communication process
Manages project costs
Minimizes project index costs
Acts as the secondary client liaison
Oversees missing equipment & related
Builds strong Rep partnerships by:
Responding to Reps in a timely manner and bringing a sense of urgency when required
Building Rep confidence by maintaining a high level of awareness on project details
Developing trust by taking responsibility for the project and owning outcomes
Initiating communication with Rep to ensure all project information is up to date
Ensuring all communication to Rep is accurate, actionable and complete
Provides accurate & complete show information by:
Delivering clear, accurate and complete data on the availability of equipment
Supplying lists of suitable substitutions to resolve equipment shortages
Only submitting those projects for confirmation that have been properly vetted
Ensuring, when relevant, that the project is a complete working system, and questioning the client on any omissions
Making sure on dry hires that the right connector types are selected for all equipment ensuring it will interface properly with the client's equipment, and questioning the clients on any omissions
Ensuring that equipment and confirmation status in Nexus is up to date and accurate
Manages the project communication process by:
Being the sole contact for the Rep for all project related communication
Being the sole contact for all support departments including Labor, Transport, Sub-Rentals, and all others for project related communication
Ensuring all requests to Transportation, Purchasing, Sub-Rentals, and Labor are accurate and contain only actionable information
Communicating directly with clients to solve equipment shortages and logistical problems
Responding to the client and Rep requests in the timeline agreed upon
Proactively pursuing an outcome that has all Nexus orders submitted for confirmation with as much advance notice as possible
Forwarding new customer billing information to Accounting Department for set-up in Nexus and Sage
Manages project costs by:
Working with other CL departments directly to develop solutions that minimize costs
Focusing on gear substitutions to cost effectively resolve equipment shortages
Selecting the most cost-effective shop(s) to pull a project out of, taking all show costs and operational costs into consideration
Staying on top of lead times to make sure that equipment and logistical issues are solved in a cost-effective manner
Making sure the Rep is clearly aware of Labor, Transport, Sub-Rental and Purchase project costs and has approved them in advance
Advising Rep of any costs associated with shop openings, trucking fees and any other miscellaneous fees
Questioning expenditures which appear to be excessive in an effort to find more efficient solutions
Minimizes project index costs by:
Suggesting gear substitutions and reductions to minimize index costs, while still ensuring an acceptable show outcome
Informing Rep of the INDEX amounts and material INDEX changes
Minimizing the number of days gear is needed on a project by reducing prep days on non-prepped gear
Acts as the secondary client liaison by:
Communicating with client as needed on technical matters such as gear selection and substitution issues
Keeping client in the loop on logistics issues such as transport and labor details
Responding to client requests for technical and logistics information
Taking adds orders and other orders directly from the client as requested by Rep
Oversees missing equipment & related by:
Managing finding missing gear, and returning it to a CL shop
Informing Rep of costs associated with missing gear
Working with Rental Admin and Rep in tracking down missing gear
Informing owners of other people's gear of its location and assisting in its return

Requirements

Personal Attributes

Self-motivated, ability to set and meet goals.
Strong organizational, planning, and decision-making skills
Communication, with a passion for collaboration over confrontation.
Encouraging leader.
Quality-conscious and team results-driven.
Excels at multitasking and adapting.

Professional Attributes

Professional entertainment lighting equipment knowledge.
Live event production and show-site experience.
Technical troubleshooting and problem-solving.
Equipment substitution and system compatibility knowledge.
Project and cost management.
Cross-functional coordination.
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines

jobs.title: Operations Project Manager
jobs.description:
Come join our family!  If you are interested in truly making a difference in a collaborative and rewarding work setting with a culture of respect, accountability, appreciation, and loyalty, Microbac might be the right place for you!

We offer a positive working environment with engaged and supportive leadership teams along with competitive pay and benefits including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, generous paid time off including vacation, holidays and flextime, a wellness program, referral bonus, tuition reimbursement and more!  

ABOUT MICROBAC

Microbac Laboratories, Inc. is a premier commercial laboratory testing firm that partners with clients nationwide, offering laboratory solutions to life science, food and nutrition, and environmental industries and serves our clients with the utmost expertise and respect for their market requirements, constraints, and challenges. We embody a company-wide commitment to exceptional customer experience, which has been refined by over 50 years of trusted, analytical and measurement experience.

As a privately held third-party testing company, Microbac operates with a commitment to our workforce, safety, quality, and compliance. Our diverse work portfolio includes broad accreditation offerings and tested insights across the environmental, food and nutrition and life science markets.

JOB SUMMARY

The Operations Project Manager will play a pivotal role in mastering, implementing, optimizing, and supporting laboratory information systems (LIMS) and other operation’s technology tools across our organization. This role combines project management, technical expertise, and data analysis to ensure smooth adoption of systems, accurate reporting, and operational excellence. The Operations Project Manager will serve as a super user and key liaison between lab teams, IT, and leadership, helping shape processes and provide guidance during system rollouts. Additionally, this role will assist executive operations by providing strategic support and may be assigned special projects as they arise, contributing to organizational priorities and initiatives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Project Manager of LIMS across multiple lab locations, coordinating with internal teams and external vendors. 

Develop and maintain executive dashboards, KPI reporting, and data analytics tools to support operational decision-making. 

Spearhead the rollout of new technologies with select teams.

Act as a LIMS super-user, providing guidance, training, and occasional remote support to labs as needed. 

Collaborate with leadership to recommend process improvements and support system enhancements. 

Maintain project schedules, track milestones, and ensure accountability across implementation teams. 

Support labs during periods of staffing challenges or system transitions, ensuring continuity of operations. 

Participate in strategic discussions regarding future technology needs and operational efficiencies. 

Travel as required for system rollouts, training sessions, and implementation support. 

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

High school diploma; plus, two years of related experience or a bachelor’s degree

Basic knowledge of principles, terminology, practices, techniques and instrumentation commonly used in a laboratory setting

Ability to effectively prioritize work and manage time to meet deadlines and rush orders

Computer literacy

Ability to communicate effectively in both written and verbal formats

Proven experience as a LIMS super-user or in laboratory systems implementation. 

Strong project management skills with a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives. 

Experience with BI/dashboard platforms and data analytics tools. 

Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills. 

Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and maintain flexibility in dynamic environments. 

Trustworthiness, reliability, and a forward-thinking approach to technology and processes.  

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience in laboratory operations or related technical environments. 

Knowledge of regulatory and compliance standards in laboratory settings. 

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

The physical demands and working conditions described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Requirements: 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools; talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit.

The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include color vision and depth perception.

This position is remote with travel. 

It is the employee's responsibility to have a feasible, secure space to work.

Working Conditions: 

Primarily remote work with scheduled travel for implementation activities. 

Occasional flexibility outside standard business hours may be required during critical rollouts or emergencies. 

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

This job will require travel during times of implementation. 

As a privately held third-party testing company, Microbac operates with a commitment to safety, quality and compliance. Our diverse work portfolio includes broad accreditation offerings and tested insights across the environmental, food and life science markets.

OTHER:

This job description is not an exhaustive list of all duties an employee may be required to perform. Microbac reserves the right to revise the job description at any time. 

Employment is at-will. Microbac, promotes a drug-free, alcohol-free workplace. Applicants considered for hire must pass a drug test before beginning work. Refusal to submit to testing will result in disqualification of further employment consideration.

Microbac is an Equal Opportunity Employer – We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Want to take your project management expertise to new levels? Come join our team of highly skilled portfolio and project managers in the Enterprise Project Management Office team. This role will be focused on support of the Integration Management Office within the EPMO and report to the Vice President of Enterprise PMO.

The Enterprise PMO is responsible for leading projects for the Transformation Office including important M&A Integration Projects. In addition to Integration projects, will also be assigned as cross-functional project leader for other high impact, Enterprise-wide projects as bandwidth and experience align.

As Project Manager, you will lead high impact Enterprise projects by leveraging deep project management expertise; manage project timeline, deliverables and execution leading cross functional teams of subject matter experts; and be accountable for stakeholder communication and risk management. Your background and experience in a specific area will support your assignments to specific projects. Primary assignments for Enterprise Project Managers will be projects that involve multiple Agilent functions and need neutral facilitation to balance multiple sponsors and stakeholders.

Specific responsibilities include
:

Lead key strategic cross-functional projects by leveraging deep project management expertise
Special emphasis on leading large cross-functional teams through an M&A Integration including close interactions with VP GMs and Executive Leadership and functional team members. Other Enterprise projects will complete your portfolio of projects when bandwidth allows.
Manage project timeline, deliverables, and execution, operating with subject matter experts in various functions as needed
Translate project needs into specific deliverables that evolve the commercial model
Ensure projects meet performance targets by adhering to processes, and follow standard tracking and reporting for projects
Monitor and escalate identified issues and performance deviations
Design stakeholder management and communication plan to customize to the needs of the project and the stakeholders. And engage with change management specialist to design and deploy change management activities
Organize and run project meetings, clearly documenting project progress using standard templates and processes
Ensure monitoring against project objectives throughout the execution
Ensure operational handover of project deliverables (processes, tools…) at project closure
Participate in continuously evolving and developing the project management center of excellence capabilities
Actively engaged in success of the project—formulates and actions solutions to address challenges.
Able to translate complex project information to critical risks and issues for senior leaders.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelors or Masters University Degree or equivalent.
10+ years of experience in project management at all levels of the organization
Solid track record of working across multiple functions in a matrixed organization. Demonstrated skill in partner management and meeting facilitation.
Agilent business acumen and familiarity with how to navigate in complex global environment
Effective interpersonal skills in teamwork, negotiation, and networking
Demonstrated ability to manage complexity and uncertainty while maintaining attention to detail.
Excellent listening and written & verbal communication skills

Preferred

Experience in M&A Processes and Stage Gate as functional lead or project leader.
Project Management certification (e.g. PMP)

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least August 24, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.

jobs.title: I/S Agile Project Manager I
jobs.description:
Join the Workplace Solutions organization and become part of a fast-paced, forward-thinking team. As an IT Agile Project Manager, you will be driving innovation as you manage the delivery of new solutions and help migrate legacy products for two Agile Release Train teams. This role will enable you to support the software development lifecycle by conducting thorough coordination, scheduling, clarification of work, and support to prioritization.
You’ll work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure the business needs are met while gaining leadership experience. You’ll also build your understanding of departmental processes, the software development life cycle, business acumen, and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies. Our culture values teamwork, innovation, and growth. We believe in supporting one another, putting customers first, embracing new ideas, and creating opportunities for associates to learn, lead, and make a meaningful impact.
WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

Estimated Salary (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications) Project Manager I: $95,000 - $115,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
Project Manager II: $110,000 - $130,000, plus annual bonus opportunity

401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Serves as a Scrum Master and process expert in a Scaled Agile environment, overseeing cross-functional teams and ensuring successful Program Increment planning and execution.
Builds and leads high-performing teams, including building strong relationships with product owners, solution leads, stakeholders, customers and other team members.
Manages run, grow and transform work including the management of project charters, budgets and measurements.
Facilitates day-to-day work coordination, prioritization, and removal of impediments. Tracks work status, manages issues, and evaluates progress, quality, and costs. Facilitates continuous improvement/growth plans for the team.
Represents team projects to IT and business partners by presenting summarized views to large groups of stakeholders and responding to questions. Facilitates and represents stakeholders in quarterly planning activities.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

5+ years of Project Management experience in IT including managing project planning, execution and delivery, financial analysis and problem resolution.
2+ years of Scrum Master Experience: Leads and facilitates Scrum events and ceremonies, removing impediments, and educating/ensuring teams follow Agile principles.
Strong communication and documentation skills including experience with JIRA, Microsoft SharePoint and the Microsoft Office suite.
Experience defining issues and opportunities for innovation, business and technology needs, and implementing solutions.
Ability to manage work across technologies, domains and business functions, including understanding comparative business values and negotiation of prioritizations.
You promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States or Puerto Rico.

PREFERRED:

General knowledge of the SDLC in a Java-based environment.
Project Management, Scrum Master, and SAFe certifications.
Servant leader mindset including supporting and developing team members, facilitating collaboration, leading by example and prioritizing the team’s success.

This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business-critical meetings.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
HEY THERE

Help us scale up Yazio, one of the world's leading nutrition apps.

As our Business Operations Manager, you'll improve how Yazio works, from AI-powered automations to company-wide operational initiatives. If you're someone who spots opportunities before others do and enjoys turning complexity into simple, scalable processes, this role is for you.

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the U.K.

YOUR MISSION

Drive operational projects from idea to implementation, including planning, stakeholder management, delivery and post-project reviews
Identify inefficient workflows and redesign them using AI, automation and smarter processes to create measurable business impact
Build and implement automation solutions that reduce manual work and help teams work more efficiently
Collaborate with teams across Yazio to roll out operational improvements and ensure lasting adoption
Own company-wide operational topics such as hardware, software licenses, tool access, subscriptions, insurance and workplace resources, enabling teams to focus on what they do best
Ensure compliance with internal processes, vendor documentation, data privacy and legal requirements while proactively identifying and mitigating operational risks
Develop scalable processes and operational infrastructure that support Yazio's continued growth

YOUR PROFILE

Relevant experience in Business Operations, Project Management or a similar operational role, ideally in a technology company, startup or scale-up
Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities simultaneously
Hands-on experience improving business processes through AI and automation, with a proven track record of delivering solutions that reduce manual work
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, fostering alignment across cross-functional teams
Comfortable using AI assistants as part of your daily workflow and always looking for opportunities to work smarter
Curiosity about legal, compliance, data protection and operational topics, combined with a willingness to continuously learn and adapt
A university degree in Business Management, Operations Management or a related field
Fluency in English and German, paired with excellent written communication skills

WHY US?

An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating
A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year
30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you
A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!
A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement
A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks
Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development
A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take Yazio to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

Your CV in English
A few lines (or a short video if you prefer) about who you are and why you want to work at Yazio
Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

About ITT

ITT Inc. (NYSE: ITT) is a diversified global leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions serving the flow, aerospace and defense, transportation, industrial, and energy markets. Through operational execution, innovation, and disciplined capital deployment, including strategic acquisitions such as SPX FLOW, ITT partners with its customers to deliver enduring solutions to the key industries that underpin our modern way of life.

Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, ITT has a market cap of roughly $20 billion and employs more than 15,000 people across 40 countries and serves customers in approximately 125 countries. Following the acquisition of SPX FLOW, the company is expected to generate $5.4 billion in annual revenue.

Our businesses are organized in three distinct segments, each based around our core engineering DNA:

Flow Technologies:
A global leader in, providing a broad portfolio of pumps, valves, mixing and agitation equipment, heat transfer, homogenizers, separation, water and wastewater treatment, and engineered process solutions.Our leading brands include the iconic Goulds Pumps
(with more than 175 years of history), Anhydro, APV, Bornemann, Bran+Luebbe, C’treat, Engineered Valves, Gerstenberg Schröder, Habonim, Johnson Pump, Lightnin, Philadelphia, Plenty, PRO Cast, Rheinhütte, Seital Separation, Stelzer, Svanehøj, Tigerholm, Uutechnic, VIDAR, Waukesha Cherry-Burrell.

Motion Technologies:
A global leader in brake pads (ICE and electrified brake pads) and shock absorbers (energy absorption solutions) for transportation applications. Our leading brands include Friction Technologies, KONI
and Axtone.

Connect and Control Technologies:
A leader in critical applications for the aerospace, defense and industrial markets, including harsh environment connectors and control components. Our leading brands include ITT Cannon, Enidine, Aerospace Controls
and kSARIA.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing engineering projects from inception through completion, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and according to specifications. This position involves coordinating project team efforts, managing communication with stakeholders, and ensuring successful project execution with minimal supervision.

Essential Responsibilities

Serve as the primary project management point of contact for assigned strategic customer accounts, ensuring clear communication and execution alignment.
Lead recurring customer meetings to communicate order status, milestone achievement, schedule updates, risks, and recovery plans.
Develop, maintain, and track detailed project schedules and milestone charts using Microsoft Project and other project management tools to ensure customer commitments are met.
Coordinate cross-functional activities across Engineering, Production Control, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and Sales to drive on-time execution of customer orders and projects.
Monitor open order status, identify schedule risks and constraints, and proactively lead corrective actions to support delivery, quality, and customer satisfaction objectives.
Escalate critical issues, resource gaps, and execution risks to leadership while driving accountability and timely resolution across functional teams.

Position Requirements

Preferred

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field
5 years minimum experience in project management of Engineering projects.
Strong knowledge of project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Microsoft Sensei, Jira, Monday.)
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Ability to identify project risk, scope creep, and missing critical requirements.
Demonstrated ability to plan and execute projects to successful completion in engineering environment.
Capacity to work in a high paced, changing environment, and interface effectively with other departments and executive management.
Strong documentation skills with the ability to create, organize, and manage detailed project documents.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective interaction with stakeholders, project teams, cross functional teams, and managers.
Ability to present complex technical information clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences.
Skilled in facilitating meetings and driving consensus among stakeholders.
Ability to address and resolve issues during the planning phase to ensure smooth project execution.
Must possess strong leadership and emotional intelligence skills with the ability to motivate and guide diverse teams.
Ability to identify and resolve issues efficiently and effectively.
Highly self-motivated and a willingness to be effective and learn.
Working knowledge of MS Office products such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
The ability to travel periodically (up to 10%).
Bachelor's degree in an Engineering or technical field.
PMP Certification
Experience in management of new product development projects.
Experience in Aerospace and/or Military/Defense industries.

This position requires use of information which is subject to the International Traffic and Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. Persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S. person, as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (e.g., Green Card Holder), Political Asylee, or Refugee

jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

At AECOM we balance the world’s need for safe, reliable water with protecting this critical natural resource for the future through a deep understanding of interconnected systems. Our professionals work in and across the major markets to deliver comprehensive solutions that safeguard human health and the environment.

We work with clients across the entire project life cycle — from initial planning studies through final construction and operations and maintenance services — on both traditional and alternative project-delivery options (design-build, public-private partnerships and financing). We design projects that are fully constructible.

AECOM's Water team is actively seeking a Project Manager
for full-time employment based in the Yellowknife, NT office. The qualified applicant will have an opportunity to contribute to a wide variety of interesting water projects that include water and wastewater conveyance and rehabilitation projects, stormwater management and urban flood mitigation and water and wastewater treatment.

Skills you will use in this job include project management, water and wastewater infrastructure design, data analysis, and report / proposal writing all in a friendly, fast-paced consulting engineering work environment at AECOM. This role offers the right candidate the potential for career progression within AECOM.

The responsibilities of this position include:
Project Management duties, including schedule and budget control, project team oversight, progress reporting
Working directly with the group manager, project engineers, engineers in training and technical staff on Water projects
Communicating with clients, meetings, project management, completing technical analysis and reviews, preparing reports and proposals, conceptual / preliminary and detailed designs of water, wastewater and stormwater management infrastructure
Utilize local knowledge and contacts to grow business and preposition for upcoming work.
In coordination with the other Water staff, support in the client follow-up and develop and maintain strong relationships with clients.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams including budgeting, scheduling and managing deliverables.
Participate in the coordination of the team's participation in key conferences and sponsorship opportunities related to the respective market sector
Participate in the development, communication and deployment of strategies to advance AECOM’s position in the Water market sector.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (civil preferred) and 6+ years of related experience specifically as a Project Manager in design and construction of municipal water infrastructure projects or other multi-disciplinary projects or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
Registered as a P.Eng. with NAPEG or ability to register within 6 months

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of related experience specifically in multi-disciplinary projects and design/construction of municipal water and wastewater treatment and pumping projects.
Experience leading people in multi-disciplinary teams.
Experience interacting with clients and being a trusted advisor.
Excellent organizational, interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills as well as effective report writing.

Additional Information

Sponsorship for Canadian employment authorization is not available for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $94000 to $165000.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Artificial intelligence will be used to support the screening, assessment, and selection of applicants for this role. Final hiring decisions are made by the hiring team.

jobs.title: Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
VVater is America’s Next Water Company, delivering the future of purification through its award-winning Farady Reactor (CES Best of Innovation 2025, World Future Award 2025, Time Best Invention Award 2025), proprietary ALTEP (Advanced Low Tension Electroporation Process), Advanced Dissolved Air Flotation, and Micro & Nano Bubble technologies. Unlike outdated chemical, filter, and membrane systems, VVater’s electric-field breakthroughs eliminate PFAS, microplastics, microorganisms, and other contaminants with record retention times, without toxic byproducts or costly consumables.

With over 4.3B gallons treated and validation from global leaders, VVater is scaling into municipal drinking water and wastewater, DPR/IPR, onsite reuse for data centers, commercial buildings, and resorts, residential purification, and consumer health water, delivering a 60% smaller footprint, 40% CapEx savings, 80% OpEx savings, and 40% less energy use.

Job Description

THIS IS AN ONSITE POSITION BASED IN AUSTIN, TEXAS - NO REMOTE OR HYBRID AVAILABILITY FOR THIS POSITION

The Operations Program Manager is the planning and execution engine of VVater's Operations organization. Reporting to the Director of Operations, you build the plans, the schedules, the systems, and the coordination that turn strategy and vision into work that is executable and measurable.

You are the person who takes a big goal and turns it into a project plan with owners, dependencies, and dates. You build the Gantt chart. You stand up the dashboard. You run the cross-functional coordination between manufacturing, field ops, engineering, procurement, and O&M. You build the lightweight tools and automations that make the whole operation run faster. You track the metrics and surface the problems before they become fires.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

This role exists to bring rigorous planning, systems, data, and coordination to a fast-scaling Operations organization. Working in close partnership with the Director of Operations and the broader operations team, the Operations Program Manager provides the structure and tooling that turn strategy and vision into executable plans and measurable results. It is a true partnership seat, and success is measured by how much more the entire Operations organization can accomplish because of it.

You translate the plan into specific, assigned actions, and you make sure every team knows what to do and by when.

This Role IS

WHAT THIS IS — AND WHAT IT IS NOT

The planning, scheduling, and program-management backbone across manufacturing, field ops, and O&M
A systems-and-tools builder who creates dashboards, trackers, automations, and lightweight internal apps
A cross-functional coordinator who keeps every team aligned and every project on track
A data and reporting engine that gives leadership real-time visibility
AI-native and software-fluent; you build tools, not just use them
A high-versatility Swiss Army knife who can jump across many types of problems

This Role IS NOT

A single-function production scheduler who only touches the factory floor
A people-management or P&L-ownership role (the Director of Operations owns that)
A purely administrative coordinator role (this requires real planning and technical skill)
A specialist who only does one thing
A 9-to-5 (more on that below)

We will be direct, because that is one of our values. This role is demanding. VVater moves at an uncommon pace, and Operations sits at the center of it. Production deadlines are real. Field deployments happen on their own schedule. Problems do not wait for Monday.

We are not asking anyone to grind for the sake of grinding. We are transparent and respectful of personal time when the operating tempo allows. But this is a foundational seat in a fast-scaling operations organization, and the right person is energized by that pace rather than drained by it.

If you need rigid, predictable hours and fully defined work, this is not your seat. If you love bringing order to fast-moving complexity and being the person who makes the whole operation run, this is exactly where you want to be.

Key Responsibilities

Planning & Program Management

Build and maintain project plans, schedules, and Gantt charts for all major operations initiatives across manufacturing, field deployment, and O&M, including critical path, dependencies, milestones, resource conflicts, and recovery plans.
Define scope, milestones, dependencies, owners, and timelines; track progress and drive accountability to dates
Manage multiple concurrent programs and projects, keeping all of them visible and on track
Anticipate bottlenecks, resource conflicts, and schedule risks, and resolve them before they become problems
Run planning tools such as Microsoft Project, or equivalent modern project and work-management platforms

Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate across manufacturing, field operations, engineering, procurement, quality, and O&M to keep work flowing
Run the operating cadence, including production and project standups, status reviews, and cross-team syncs
Serve as the connective tissue that keeps every team aligned on priorities, timelines, and hand-offs
Translate the Director of Operations' vision and priorities into concrete, assigned, tracked action

Data, Reporting & Dashboards

Build and maintain operations dashboards and reporting across production output, project status, KPIs, utilization, and performance metrics
Use Power BI, Excel, or equivalent tools to turn raw operational data into clear, actionable visibility for leadership
Establish and track the metrics that matter across manufacturing, field ops, and O&M
Provide the Director of Operations and executive team with accurate, real-time operational reporting

Systems, Tools & Automation

Build internal tools, trackers, and automations that make the operations organization faster and more efficient
Vibe-code internal applications, automations, dashboards, forms, and workflows when a fast build beats a slow manual process or an expensive vendor tool.
Use modern AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Grok, and others) to accelerate planning, documentation, analysis, and coordination
Own and improve the operations technology stack in coordination with IT, including work-management, ERP, scheduling, and reporting tools. Operations-side power user/administrator, not just familiarity.
Document processes, build SOPs, and create the operating infrastructure that lets the organization scale

Execution Support

Jump in wherever the operation needs an extra set of capable hands; this is a high-versatility role
Support procurement, logistics, and materials coordination as needed to keep production and field work moving
Prepare operational documentation, reports, and presentations for internal and customer-facing use
Take ownership of ad-hoc operational projects and see them through to completion

Qualifications

5+ years in operations program management, project management, production planning, manufacturing operations, or a similar structured operations role
Demonstrated mastery of project planning and scheduling (Microsoft Project, Gantt charts, or equivalent) with a track record of keeping complex projects on time
Strong data and reporting skills (Power BI, advanced Excel, or equivalent); you can turn operational data into clear dashboards and insights
Software and technical fluency; comfortable learning and configuring tools, and able to build lightweight internal tools or automations, including vibe-coding with modern AI
Hands-on fluency with AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or equivalents)
Experience in manufacturing, hardware, industrial, construction, energy, or field services operations

PMP, CAPM, CPIM, Lean, or Six Sigma certification
Experience supporting both factory/production operations and field operations or O&M
Real examples of internal tools, dashboards, automations, or apps you have personally built
Water, wastewater, or utility industry exposure
Proven cross-functional coordination experience; you have kept multiple teams aligned and moving
Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through
Strong written and verbal communication
Comfort with ambiguity and rapid change; ability to work independently and build your own structure

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

AECOM is actively seeking an experienced Project Manager a strong technical background in mine closure, mine site remediation, or northern contaminated sites to join our Environment Business Line in support of the Faro Mine Remediation Program. The right candidate can work locally from our Burnaby, BC, Calgary AB or Edmonton, AB office and AECOM can provide hybrid work options to give the flexibility you need to do your best work. We are looking for a candidate that has a can-do attitude, is enthusiastic, team-oriented professional, with a strong project management background. The appropriately qualified candidate will have a strong understanding and experience in project management and technical experience related to mine closure, tailings/contaminated materials management, or mine‑site infrastructure decommissioning.

So why join us? At AECOM you can join our local, and global, world class team of technical and project management professionals where you’ll get to work on various multi-disciplinary and high-profile projects across the country. The project management role will focus on supporting ongoing solid waste management and remediation projects across Western Canada but will also interface with other projects within AECOM’s Environment business.

We have multiple and varied project opportunities and are seeking strong candidates and great people to join our talented team. If you’re ready for the challenge of working in a fast paced, multi-disciplinary environment - this is the career opportunity for you!

Demonstrated experience managing multi-disciplinary projects.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong interpersonal and organizational skills
Strong client management skills
Valid driver's license
Proficient with MS Office Suite; excellent knowledge of Project, Excel, and Word
Travel to Faro, Yukon

15+ years of experience directly with construction management
Technical background in mine closure, tailings, waste rock, or reclamation.
Experience on large or northern mine remediation programs.
Strong background in QA/QC, risk management and technical review.
Experience with Federal Agencies such as Public Service and Procurement Canada.

Highly developed written communication, time management and organizational skills
Demonstrated interpersonal skills; conduct yourself with integrity, work within multi-disciplined teams, deal with complex issues, and maintain effective working relationships

Here, you will have freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed. You will help us foster a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion – a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
We will encourage you to grow and develop your career with us through our technical and professional development programs and diverse career opportunities. We believe in leadership at all levels. No matter where you sit in the organization you can make a lasting impact on the projects you work on, the teams and committees you join and our business.
We offer competitive pay and benefits, well-being programs to support you and your family, and the development resources you need to advance your career.
When you join us, you will connect and collaborate with a global network of experts – planners, designers, engineers, scientists, consultants, program and construction managers – leading the change toward a more sustainable and equitable future. Join us and let’s get started.

jobs.description:
New Leaf Energy is an experienced clean energy developer that partners with landowners, policymakers, and other stakeholders to accelerate the transition to a world powered by renewable energy. We identify high-value sites, work with landowners and local communities to develop them, and partner with long-term asset owners to bring the most impactful clean energy projects to life.

Position Summary

The Project Manager, IPP (“PM”) is responsible for the day-to-day execution of projects during construction and commissioning. This role manages contractors, schedules, budgets, and site activities to ensure projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with approved plans. The PM operates within established cost, schedule, and technical frameworks and escalates risks, changes, and issues in accordance with the IPP’s organizational and governance structures.

Position Responsibilities Will Include, But Are Not Limited To

Project Execution

Lead day-to-day execution of assigned projects to commercial operation.
Serve as the IPP’s primary point of contact for EPC contractors, major suppliers, and third-party inspectors during construction, escalating commercial disputes or high-impact technical issues
Support commissioning, performance testing, and punch-list resolution.
Prepare and organize COD documentation and turnover materials.
Review EPC Contractor and vendor compliance with PWA, insurance, and other contract requirements
Identify and document contractor performance issues or contract deviations, escalating to senior leadership for formal notice preparation and resolution
Assist in organizing commissioning schedules, tracking punch-list items to completion, and compiling turnover documentation for the Asset Management team.

Schedule, Cost, and Reporting

Maintain and update detailed project schedules and construction plans.
Track weekly project expenditures against approved budget, update progress tracking models, and review contractor invoices against progress tracking models.
Prepare accurate, timely project reports for senior leadership, lenders, and internal stakeholders.
Identify schedule and cost risks early and escalate with clear documentation and recommendations.

Change Management

Identify potential changes in scope, cost, or schedule and initiate change orders.
Coordinate technical evaluation with the Director of Engineering and commercial review with senior leadership.
Log potential change orders, collect backup documentation (cost estimates, schedule impacts) from contracts, and support senior management in reviewing change order packages.
Implement approved changes and track execution impacts.

Quality, Safety and Compliance

Conduct routine site visits, safety observations, and progress verification.
Coordinate factory acceptance testing logistics, schedules, and documentation with vendors, EPCs, and Engineering.
Escalate safety incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
Support incident investigations and corrective action implementation in coordination with senior leadership and contractors.

Desired Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
At least three years of renewable energy construction or project management experience (IPP or EPC).
Strong understanding of construction sequencing, contractor management, and site safety.
Experience supporting change management and contract administration.
Excellent communication, organization, and escalation judgment.

Compensation

New Leaf Energy compensates all employees in three ways: market-competitive base salary, plus above-market variable compensation, plus an equity-like program such that all employees experience the benefits of ownership. We use a data-driven and transparent methodology to calibrate compensation that is externally competitive and internally equitable, guided by the New Leaf Energy compensation manual, which is available to all employees.

Under our compensation framework, the likely base salary range for this position in the Boston location is $117,043 - 136,939. The on-target annual cash bonus associated with this position is an additional 10% percent of base salary. Your actual salary may be above, in, or below this range, depending on your location and experience.

We value transparency and can share more during the interview process.

Benefits And Culture

New Leaf Energy’s success is driven by our collaborative, long-term relationships based on trust and transparency. We offer a flexible work environment that places significant responsibility in independent teams and creates opportunities for innovation and personal growth. New Leaf Energy’s benefits are designed to appropriately recognize our employees’ contributions and enable a reasonable work/life balance. Our benefits include:

Competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental and vision;
A 401k plan with immediate vesting and a company match (100% of the first three percent of your pay; 50% for the next two percent you contribute);
An open and self-managed paid time-off policy;
A hybrid work location policy that supports working from home for part of the week;
A parental leave policy for both birthing and non-birthing parents, available immediately upon hire;
Professional development and education assistance.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

New Leaf Energy values the diverse perspectives, skills, experiences, and contributions of all employees. We want all our employees to feel like they belong and are empowered to be their most authentic selves at work. We’re actively committed to fostering diversity and creating an inclusive environment not only within our own organization but also within the clean energy industry.

We seek a diverse candidate pool in this–and every–search. New Leaf Energy provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetics, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state, federal and local laws. In addition to federal law requirements, New Leaf Energy complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. EEO M/F/D/V.

A Note to Third-Party Recruiters

New Leaf Energy’s People + Culture team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. Resumes are only accepted from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies if a signed agreement is in place AND if external recruiting assistance is authorized by the People + Culture team for a specific position. jobs.title: Program Manager, Product Management
jobs.description:
The Program Manager provides Product Management leadership with a single, trustworthy view of progress on the organization's strategic, large-scale initiatives.
Examples include: product modernization, AI, and other transformational projects across a portfolio of 40+ industry-specific software products. Working at the intersection of product, engineering, and leadership, the Program Manager owns accurate status reporting, milestone tracking, and risk visibility for these key projects, translating complex project details into clear, decision-ready reporting for executives and stakeholders.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role that succeeds through influence, disciplined communication, and data rather than direct authority. The Program Manager works directly with product owners and cross-functional project teams to keep high-stakes initiatives on track, and gives leadership a real-time, honest picture of progress across the organization's most important product bets.

What You'll Do

Manage and Report on Key Strategic Initiatives

Manage and support key large-scale product projects. Actively manage progress on the organization's strategic product initiatives including product modernization, AI/ML integration, and other transformational, multi-quarter projects as examples, partnering closely with product owners and project teams to keep work moving against plan.
Own status reporting to leadership. Build and maintain accurate, timely, executive-ready status reports and dashboards for key projects, giving leadership a clear, consolidated view of progress, milestones, budget/resourcing status, and delivery timelines across the portfolio.
Track project health and key metrics. Define and monitor the milestones, KPIs, and success metrics for each large-scale initiative, translating detailed project activity into concise, decision-ready insight for leadership and flagging projects that are off track.

Keep Initiatives On Track

Identify and escalate risks and issues. Proactively identify risks, issues, blockers, and cross-team dependencies threatening a project's scope, schedule, or quality; maintain a clear view of open items and escalate to leadership with recommended paths forward.
Run project governance and cadence. Establish and facilitate a regular cadence of project reviews and checkpoints with project teams and leadership ensuring each key initiative has a consistent forum for reporting progress, making decisions, and resolving blockers.
Drive accountability across project teams. Hold project owners and cross-functional contributors (engineering, design, product marketing, product management, sales, customer success) accountable to committed timelines and deliverables, following up on action items and unresolved issues between checkpoints.

Communicate and Support Decision-Making

Communicate with stakeholders. Tailor communication of project status and impact for different audiences, from individual project teams to senior executives, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned throughout each initiative's lifecycle.
Support prioritization and planning. Provide leadership with the visibility needed to make informed trade-off and sequencing decisions across the portfolio of large-scale initiatives, based on current progress, risk, and resourcing.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager
to lead the development and integration of a wearable medical device platform combining embedded hardware (sensors, PCBs, mechanical/electrical subsystems) with a cloud-native software platform. This role owns the program schedule end-to-end across hardware and software workstreams, with particular emphasis on sequencing software delivery against hardware development milestones — since hardware lead times (PCB fabrication, component procurement, mechanical tooling, bring-up, and safety verification) typically drive the critical path and dictate the overall program timeline.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the integrated hardware/software program schedule, ensuring software delivery milestones are sequenced against hardware readiness (PCB fab, component lead times, mechanical builds, bring-up, and compliance testing) rather than planned independently.
Coordinate across mechanical, electrical, and firmware engineering teams (internal and partner/vendor) alongside software and cloud engineering teams.
Track hardware long-lead procurement (components, transducers, PCB fabrication, backup sourcing) and proactively flag schedule risk to downstream software and integration workstreams.
Manage the hardware-software interface: sensor specifications, communication protocols/APIs (e.g., BLE, USB-C), firmware-to-cloud data pipelines, and version-locking between hardware spec releases and software builds.
Lead end-to-end software platform delivery (cloud backend, real-time data pipeline, clinician dashboard) using Agile/Scrum methodologies, timed to hardware integration windows.
Coordinate hardware bring-up, bench validation, and safety/compliance verification (e.g., acoustic output, electrode SNR, mechanical fit) alongside software integration testing.
Manage project plans, risks, and dependencies across multiple hardware and software partner organizations; escalate cross-partner blockers early given the schedule sensitivity of hardware workstreams.
Facilitate technical reviews, milestone/compliance demonstrations, and executive status reporting spanning both hardware and software progress.
Support healthcare interoperability initiatives, including HL7/FHIR-based integrations, for the software layer.
Ensure hardware and software development follow security-by-design, safety, and regulatory compliance best practices (including support for FDA engagement where applicable).
Manage vendor, partner, and stakeholder relationships across hardware suppliers, software delivery partners, and clinical/regulatory stakeholders.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. (Computer Science/Information Systems background considered only with demonstrated hardware program management experience.)
5+ years of Technical Program Management or Systems Integration experience on programs combining hardware and software development.
Demonstrated experience managing hardware development lifecycles — component sourcing/lead times, PCB fabrication, mechanical builds, bring-up, and verification/validation — and understanding how they constrain downstream software and integration schedules.
Strong knowledge of embedded systems, hardware-software interfaces (APIs, communication protocols), and cloud/software architecture.
Experience leading Agile software delivery teams in coordination with hardware engineering teams.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills across both hardware and software disciplines.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing schedules in a fast-paced, cross-functional, multi-partner environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in medical device development, wearable/embedded health tech, or SaMD/hardware-inclusive regulated products.
Familiarity with supply chain and long-lead component procurement strategies (backup sourcing, single-supplier risk mitigation).
Experience supporting research, government-funded, or highly regulated hardware/software technology programs.

Nice to have Qualifications:

Experience with hardware verification & validation, safety testing, and regulatory submission support (e.g., FDA Q-Sub/510(k) pathway).
Knowledge of HL7, FHIR, and healthcare interoperability standards.
Experience with cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD, DevOps, observability tooling.

Hardware Schedule & Critical Path Management

API & Systems Integration
Agile/Scrum Software Delivery

Healthcare/Medical Device Technology
Cross-Functional Leadership

Help Us Build AI That Helps People

We’re looking for a creative, highly organized, and technology-minded Technology Project Manager – AI & Digital Innovation
to join our team and help build the next generation of digital well-being experiences.
A major focus of this role will be supporting the continued development of Bree AI Life Coach
—an AI-powered experience designed to help people better understand themselves, navigate everyday challenges, set meaningful goals, build healthier habits, and improve their overall mental health and well-being.
This is not a traditional project management role
where you’ll spend your days simply updating project plans and scheduling meetings.

You’ll help organize, build, test, create, and innovate.

You'll work alongside software developers, AI specialists, product leaders, coaches, and other team members to turn ideas into real digital experiences. You'll also get hands-on experience with emerging AI technologies, AI-generated video and content, and the testing and improvement of the experiences we create.

If you're fascinated by AI, enjoy technology, are exceptionally organized and communicative, and want your work to have a positive impact on people's lives, we'd like to meet you.

What You'll Do

Help Build & Grow Bree AI Life Coach

Coordinate the development of new Bree AI Life Coach features and experiences

Work closely with software developers, AI specialists, product leaders, coaches, and other stakeholders
Help translate ideas and business needs into clear requirements and actionable development projects
Participate in product discussions and help move ideas from concept through development and release
Help evaluate Bree's user experience and continually ask: How can we make this more helpful, personal, engaging, and human?

Research and experiment with emerging AI technologies that could improve Bree and the experiences we provide
See projects move from an idea to technology that is actually being used to help people

Own the Details & Keep Projects Moving

Organization, follow-through, and communication are central to this position.
You'll:
Coordinate multiple technology and AI initiatives from planning through completion
Maintain project plans, requirements, priorities, tasks, timelines, and deliverables
Communicate frequently with team members and stakeholders about progress and next steps
Follow up proactively to keep projects moving
Identify roadblocks and work with the appropriate people to resolve them
Coordinate work across technical, product, creative, and business teams
Document requirements, decisions, processes, and project status
Help bring structure, visibility, and accountability to fast-moving projects

We're looking for someone who doesn't wait until a deadline is missed to find out what happened. You naturally follow up, ask questions, communicate, and keep people moving in the same direction.

Play an Active Role in UAT & Product Quality
An important part of this role will be helping ensure that what we build actually works the way we intended—for the people using it.
You'll participate directly in User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
for new features, enhancements, and releases.
This may include:
Developing and executing UAT scenarios based on requirements and expected user experiences
Testing new features from the user's perspective
, not simply checking whether they technically work
Identifying bugs, inconsistencies, usability issues, and opportunities to improve the experience
Clearly documenting issues and communicating them to development teams
Validating fixes and retesting features before release
Helping confirm that completed development meets the original requirements and business objectives
Asking the important question: “Does this actually work the way we intended for the person using it?”

Get Hands-On With AI

Work with platforms such as Synthesia, HeyGen, InVideo, ElevenLabs
, or similar tools

, and other generative AI platforms

We're much more interested in finding someone who is curious, creative, technically comfortable, willing to experiment, and able to learn new technologies quickly.

Who We're Looking For
This could be an ideal next step for someone who has developed a strong foundation in technology or project management and is ready for more responsibility, more variety, and more opportunity to grow.

Approximately 2–5 years of professional experience
in technology, project management, software, digital production, or a related area
Demonstrated experience organizing projects and keeping multiple priorities moving
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Native English (min High Fluency)
Exceptional organization and follow-through
Strong attention to detail
Comfort working with both technical and non-technical team members
Experience or comfort with hands-on UAT/software testing

Ability to clearly document bugs, requirements, feedback, and expected outcomes
Ability to learn new technology quickly
Genuine interest in AI and emerging technologies

Creativity and willingness to experiment with new ideas
Ability to work independently and communicate proactively in a remote environment
An interest in using technology to positively impact mental health, well-being, personal growth, and people's everyday lives

Even Better If You Have
You don't need to check every box, but we'd be especially interested in experience with:
PMP, CAPM, Scrum, Agile
, or other project management training/certification
Jira or similar project tracking platforms
Agile software development environments
User Acceptance Testing (UAT), QA, software testing, or release validation
Creating test scenarios, documenting defects, and validating software fixes
AI-powered applications or generative AI
Synthesia, HeyGen, InVideo, ElevenLabs, or similar AI content tools
ChatGPT, Claude, or other generative AI platforms
Creating or editing digital video content
User experience or product testing
Wellness, coaching, behavioral health, healthcare, or other mission-driven technology

Why This Opportunity Is Different
You'll be working on technology with a purpose.

Bree AI Life Coach is being built to help people better understand themselves, navigate challenges, develop greater self-awareness, set meaningful goals, and take positive steps toward improving their lives and well-being.
You'll also be joining us during an extraordinary period in technology.
AI is evolving rapidly. Advances in conversational AI, voice, video, personalization, and intelligent digital experiences are creating possibilities that didn't exist just a few years ago.

We're looking for someone who already has a solid professional foundation but wants an opportunity to learn, take ownership, expand their skills, and become an increasingly important part of a growing technology and AI organization.

r to lead the end-to-end technical delivery of our development programs. In this role, you will own technical planning and cross-functional execution to ensure program success. Systems and engineering mindset - the ability to understand and assess technical concept. Identifying system dependencies, interfaces, technical risks and the impact of key architectural decisions with the engineering team.
Execution focused - digging into the details, charting the path and owning the outcome. You will be expected to utilize your technical aptitude in conjunction with your program management, and leadership skills to deliver the best outcome for Anduril and the customer.

Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences
Comfortable with 50% travel

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. jobs.title: ExploR&D Pharma Project Manager (EPPM)

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Organization Overview

Lilly Catalyze360 is a comprehensive approach to enabling the early-stage biotech ecosystem by democratizing access to infrastructure, expertise, and resources. Through its interconnected pillars—Lilly Ventures, Lilly Gateway Labs, Lilly ExploR&D, and Lilly TuneLab—Catalyze360 strategically removes barriers that traditionally block bold science from becoming life-changing medicines, providing biotechs with flexible combinations of capital, physical lab space, R&D capabilities, AI/ML tools, and decades of enterprise learning.

Lilly ExploR&D is a team of drug discovery and development experts who partner with biotechs from discovery through clinical proof-of-concept, putting Lilly's industry-leading capabilities behind their missions. We provide flexible support—from strategic consulting to full program execution—making it faster, easier, and more capital-efficient for innovators to transform bold science into life-changing medicines.

Job Summary

The ExploR&D Pharma Project Manager (EPPM) serves as the key operational resource for external collaboration projects spanning molecule discovery through clinical proof-of-concept within Lilly's ExploR&D organization. The role requires the EPPM to coordinate cross-functional, multi-workstream timelines, risk grids, and decision and action tracking, ensure complete and accurate programmatic and portfolio-level data collected across the portfolio, enabling cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality results on time and on budget. The EPPM keeps deliverables on track and ensures accountable cross-functional SMEs deliver on upcoming deadlines, escalating risks and operational issues to organizational and alliance leadership. The EPPM plays a key role in delivering operational and process improvements that enable and optimize program delivery across ExploR&D. Based in San Diego, the EPPM partners closely with Lilly-BioTDR on Molecule Discovery projects and with the ExploR&D-China team on the ERD-APAC portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Project and Alliance Management

Manage collaborations including:
Initiate and maintain program tracking including project timelines, security access controls, internal and external communications including meeting minutes, risk grids and decision logs to support programs and enable communication with leadership.
Create and lead internal project team meetings in partnership with Program Leads and internal ExploR&D scientific leads and provide oversight for project progression and serve as a resource to the team to break down barriers.
Manage timeline and budgets set by management for projects and operations, and lead large project(s) with greater risk, resource, and financial complexity.

Serve as alliance management point of contact along with partnered ExploR&D Program Lead to the external collaboration partner ensuring mutual contractual obligations are being met between parties, and work to resolve issues as they arise, working with Catalyze360 leadership and legal as needed.
Drive communication of key decisions/results to stakeholders including creating and providing program updates (i.e. timeline, budget, relationship health) as necessary to External Innovation leadership.

External R&D Solutions Enablement

Work with External Innovation peers across Catalyze360 teams to identify new potential solutions that directly address the needs/pain points of internal teams and biotech companies and enhance current partnerships.
Participate in deal team processes by providing input on available capabilities, scope of work, workplan creation, resource estimations, and functional area capacity for inclusion into collaboration agreements.
Identify internal and external customer requirements and develop solutions to meet partner needs, building and maintaining relationships with internal and external customers and partners.
Partner closely with Lilly-BioTDR on Molecule Discovery projects, providing project and alliance management support across discovery-stage collaborations.
Partner with the ExploR&D-China team on the ERD-APAC portfolio, supporting alignment of program strategy, timelines, and resourcing across geographies.

People Leadership and Partnership Mindset

Create a performance culture and an environment of cooperation and mutual respect in line with Team Lilly expectations.
Actively build and manage relationships with Lilly internal business partners (including but not limited to Lilly Ventures, Gateway Labs, Functional Area S&E, Therapeutic Areas, etc.) to ensure a positive and productive working environment.
Build and maintain short- and long-term trusting relationships with external partners. Effectively represent Lilly overall and external R&D strategies to external organizations.

Minimum Requirements

We are seeking a Network Program Manager to lead the planning, vendor coordination, risk management, and execution of a 400G Next-Generation Network program for one of the busiest airports in the United States. This role will own the program's schedule, risk posture, and cross-team execution, with direct accountability for delivering critical network infrastructure upgrades that support 24/7 airport operations and enable future technologies such as IoT, AI, and video analytics.
The successful candidate is a hands-on program leader who can translate a complex, multi-vendor network deployment into a disciplined schedule, clear risk visibility, and measurable operational readiness for a mission-critical government environment. This role requires deep technical program management authority, paired with the judgment to operate inside the constraints of airport security, safety, and operational protocols.
Key Responsibilities

Program Management and Project Planning

Develop comprehensive, end-to-end project plans covering all 400G upgrade, deployment, and migration activities.
Apply appropriate project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid) suitable for multiple technical workstreams.
Define critical path activities, resource needs, and sequencing, and maintain schedules based on progress, emerging risks, and stakeholder input.

Requirements and Technical Alignment

Document technical design requirements, functional specifications, and dependencies needed for 400G deployment.
Facilitate design reviews and maintain traceability between requirements, design artifacts, and deployment deliverables.

Network Upgrade and Deployment Management

Oversee installation, configuration, and testing of 400G infrastructure, including high-capacity routers and modules.
Coordinate lab validation, QA testing, staging, and proof-of-concept activities prior to field deployment.
Manage field deployment sequencing, production rollout, and readiness checks.

Risk, Vendor, and Operational Readiness

Maintain a risk, issue, and dependency register, and coordinate escalation of critical blockers.
Align installation and testing activities across engineering, operations, field services, and vendor resources.
Coordinate system testing, monitoring integration, and telemetry validation, and ensure operations teams receive updated runbooks and SOPs prior to each deployment phase.

Hardware Lifecycle Support

Assist with lifecycle planning and end-of-service analysis for network assets impacted by the 400G upgrades.

Required Qualifications

Minimum ten (10) years of experience in technical program management, leading large-scale, complex enterprise technology programs.
Demonstrated experience overseeing high-capacity network infrastructure upgrades, data center expansion, or MPLS transport modernization within mission-critical environments.
Proven leadership of at least one enterprise-wide network modernization initiative involving 400G deployment, backbone/optical transport modernization, or comparable large-scale transformation.
Proficiency with enterprise scheduling and program management tools such as Microsoft Project or Primavera P6, including Gantt charts, milestone maps, and critical-path analysis.
Experience managing vendor relationships, SLAs, contract deliverables, and change control processes.
